# CWE-798: HockeyApp token — 32 hex after hockey.
# HockeyApp keys after hockey keyword are secrets; rule flags 32 hex.
# ruleid: detected-hockeyapp
hockeyapp token = "abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890"
# ruleid: detected-hockeyapp
hockey_api_token: '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef'
# ok: detected-hockeyapp
hockey token="short"
# ok: detected-hockeyapp
not-a-token
# ruleid: detected-hockeyapp
hockeyapp token = "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"
# ruleid: detected-hockeyapp
hockeyapp_api: 'cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc'
# ok: detected-hockeyapp
hockeyapp token = "short_placeholder_example"
